readiness.title: Readiness check
readiness.subtitle: Check whether this device meets the requirements for Pocket.

summary.ready: Pairing, jailbreak, SSH and AppSync installation checks passed.
summary.needsPreparation: Some prerequisites need preparation. Review the checks below.
summary.unsupported: This device or OS version is not supported yet.
summary.needsAttention: Some readiness conditions are still unknown. Review the checks and connection diagnostics.

modelSupported.title: Model
modelSupported.pass: iPod touch (4th generation) is on the supported list.

osVersionSupported.title: OS version
osVersionSupported.pass: This model and OS version are supported.
osVersionSupported.fail: This OS version is outside the supported range.
osVersionSupported.warn: Limited support for this OS version.
osVersionSupported.unknown: OS version could not be read.

pairingTrusted.title: Pairing
pairingTrusted.pass: A pairing connection is established with this computer.
pairingTrusted.fail: The device does not trust this computer yet.
pairingTrusted.warn: The pairing record may be stale.
pairingTrusted.unknown: Pairing state could not be confirmed.

jailbroken.title: Jailbreak
jailbroken.pass: Jailbreak components and device services were detected.
jailbroken.fail: The device is not jailbroken. The Pocket runtime needs a jailbroken environment.
jailbroken.unknown: There is insufficient jailbreak evidence. An unavailable AFC2 service does not prove the device is stock.

sshAvailable.title: SSH
sshAvailable.unknown: SSH could not be verified. No login or command was attempted.

batteryLevel.title: Battery
batteryLevel.warn: Battery is below 50%. Charge before preparing the device.
batteryLevel.unknown: Battery level could not be read.

physicalButtons.title: Physical buttons
physicalButtons.fail: Buttons are broken; DFU mode cannot be entered.
physicalButtons.unknown: You will confirm during preparation that the Power and Home buttons work.

normalMode.title: Device mode
normalMode.pass: The device is in Normal mode.
normalMode.fail: The device is not in normal mode. Supported DFU devices can open a preparation plan directly; return other modes to normal iOS first.

appSyncInstalled.title: AppSync installation
appSyncInstalled.pass: AppSync is installed. If an IPA signature is still rejected, check plugin loading and signing compatibility.
appSyncInstalled.fail: AppSync is missing. Prepare application installation support first.
appSyncInstalled.unknown: AppSync could not be inspected. Unknown does not mean missing; the preparation flow can inspect and provision it over SSH.

jailbreak.title: A jailbreak is required before the device can join Pocket
jailbreak.body: This demo visualizes the Legacy iOS Kit ramdisk preparation flow. Review the risks, then follow the Power and Home button animation.
jailbreak.point1: The method does not intend to erase data, but recovery from a failure may erase it. Back up first.
jailbreak.point2: The Power and Home buttons must both work.
jailbreak.point3: Do not unplug the cable or let the computer sleep. The whole flow takes about 5 minutes.

guidance.ready: Core requirements are met. You can browse the app store.
